caption: The drawing depicts two similarly shaped, carved objects that resemble drinking horns or powder horns. Both objects are shown against a plain, off-white background with no additional elements. Each object appears tubular, tapering towards one end that is fitted with a darker, turned wooden or similarly textured mouthpiece. The main body of each horn is rendered in shades of tan, beige, and muted green, suggesting aged or weathered material. Decorative motifs are visible on the surface, primarily a raised design of a rooster in profile, as well as a pattern resembling scalloped or zigzag edging along the upper rim. The horns are positioned upright with their wider ends at the top and narrower, mouthpiece ends at the bottom, with one horn shown at a slightly different angle from the other, revealing more of its side.
title: Powder Horn
